I’m also obsessed with the skin on my face and hands. I see bumps, rough spots, little marks, and I can’t leave them alone. I’ll stand in the bathroom picking and scratching, trying to smooth everything out. Sometimes I tear it up so bad I bleed, then I’m even more ashamed and cover it with my hat or long sleeves.

Because of all this, I’ve been feeling really down. I avoid church and family gatherings because I’m sure everyone is judging how I look. I’ve lost interest in things I used to enjoy, but it all seems tied to how disgusted I feel about my body.
